operational_criteria.estimated_global_reporting: Report estimated-global separately from oracle-global; estimated_global_minus_oracle_global_gate_rmse quantifies finite-sample confusion-estimation noise.
operational_criteria.success_rule: Positive-correlation conditions must have at least a 20 percentage-point higher oracle-global-worse rate than negative-correlation controls, with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound above 0. Bias-bound diagnostic Spearman rho must be >= 0.50 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound above 0.
